speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. To help pinpoint the cause of your fatigue and itching, could you tell me if you have noticed any yellowing of your skin or eyes, or any changes in the color of your urine or stool? Also, have you experienced any abdominal pain or swelling recently?

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your history of ulcerative colitis, have you noticed any darkening of your urine or pale, clay-colored stools, which might suggest bile duct obstruction? Also, do you have any history of autoimmune conditions in your family, or have you noticed any joint pain or skin rashes?
